author: Kat (@katinnnky)
title: Looking for a human artist for paid short-story illustrations
content:
Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work.

NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art.

I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story.

Contact: DM @katinnnky on Threads

author: @nllnne_du
title: Hiring thumbnail designer for YouTube channels
content:
HIRING: THUMBNAIL DESIGNER

We’re looking for a creative Thumbnail Designer for lore and documentary-style YouTube channels.

Pay: $50 per thumbnail design

Requirements:
• Experience creating YouTube thumbnails
• Strong composition and visual storytelling
• Good understanding of CTR-focused design
• Proficient in Photoshop or similar software
• Able to follow a specific visual direction
• Portfolio required
• Reliable and able to meet deadlines

A short unpaid trial will be required.

Contact: DM @nllnne_du on Threads
